Bien ubicada para hacer una parada al ir de Rosario a Buenos Aires, buena atención y si bien no fui muchas veces, la comida está bien y a precios razonables. El lugar es cómodo y la zona tranquila, ya que si bien se llega desde la ruta 9, está a cierta distancia, se puede descansar un rato y seguir viaje.

(Translated by Google)
Well located for a stop on the way from Rosario to Buenos Aires, the service is good, and although I haven't been there many times, the food is decent and reasonably priced. The place is comfortable and the area is quiet; although you can get there from Route 9, it's a bit of a drive, so you can rest for a while and continue your trip.
